name: Apply Ceiling Finish (Spray, No Backroll)
intent: Spray ceiling finish without backroll pass. QT2/QT3 economy fallback when crew can't accommodate a backroller. Single coat. Faster but produces a more textured laydown that's acceptable on a ceiling because viewing distance is greater than walls.
doctrine: Single-pass spray rate (550 SF/hr) is ~22% faster than spray+backroll combined effective rate. Source spec gates this to QT2/QT3 only — QT4/QT5 require a backroller for laydown uniformity that meets premium inspection standards.
